verdict.rationale: Evidence strongly documents Bevy's data-oriented ECS architecture (bevy-docs-1, bevy-docs-14, bevy-docs-20) and community praise for its ECS ergonomics (bevy-comm-3, bevy-comm-17), but there is no mention of a built-in profiler/tracing tool, explicit parallel job scheduling, or GPU instancing support anywhere in the pack. Missing for 10: evidence of a real profiler (e.g. Tracy integration or built-in perf tooling), explicit documentation of the job/task scheduler for parallel ECS systems, and instancing support for heavy scenes.
